canonical_project: Jeonnam/Gwangyang Cloud Data Center at Hwanggeum Industrial Complex
owner: Jeonnam Cloud Data Center Co.; KT; Microsoft Korea; Gwangyang GI
notes: Gwangyang Bay Area Free Economic Zone notice says a 40MW hyperscale cloud data center is being built in Gwangyang Hwanggeum Industrial Complex. Yonhap reported the 2023 investment agreement and target completion by end-2025; ETNews later reported a project task force, 750 billion KRW investment, and two 20MW facilities with October 2024 groundbreaking target. No later completion confirmation found in this pass.
